# Daily Briefing – Thursday 29 October

Yesterday was a rest day, which is fine, but the recovery picture is telling a story worth paying attention to. You burned 2,538 kcal with just 7,151 steps, which is solid baseline activity, but only 4.5 hours of sleep is the real concern here.

That HRV of 65ms is significantly below your baseline of 97-120ms, almost certainly driven by that poor sleep. Your body is waving a yellow flag. If you have a session planned today, dial the intensity back — think easy aerobic work only, nothing that pushes your heart rate into threshold territory.

On nutrition, prioritise sleep tonight above everything else. But today, hit your 175g protein target consistently across meals rather than back-loading it — this actively supports recovery when your HRV is suppressed. Aim for lights out before 10pm tonight. Chester is 166 days away; protect the process.
